parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Wallpaper/Tests/WallpaperTests/QualityMetricsAggregatorTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity is high (0.778), the two methods — `calculatesAvgShaderFPS` (line 319) and `recordsInterpolatorResets` (line 461) — test distinct behaviours of `QualityMetricsAggregator` (shader FPS averaging vs. interpolator reset recording). Near-duplicate structure in test methods is common when tests share setup/assertion scaffolding but exercise different logical paths; collapsing them would obscure test intent and violate the one-assertion-per-test principle. No production code is involved, so there is no maintenance risk from the duplication.
